notes.title: TGS Production Showcase & Key Schedule Announcement
notes.notes: [p][b]Together We Run, Bound by Destiny[/b][/p][p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The first day of TGS 2025 Business Day has finally begun!✨[/p][p][/p][p]At today’s stage program, we presented the <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Production Announcement Event, featuring various content including behind-the-scenes development stories, character introductions, and an in-game demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Most importantly, we announced the key schedules you have all been waiting for![/p][p]Please check the details below for more information![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✦ TGS Production Showcase & Key Schedule Announcement ✦[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/1b8011d5c122b13d922e288f2435e43299703a4e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🔹[b]Key Schedules[/b][/p][p]- Official Launch Date: January 28, 2026[/p][p]- CBT Period: October 30 (Thu) - November 5 (Wed) (KST)[/p][p][i]* Details on the schedules will be further announced in a separate notice.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]🔹[b]TGS Production Showcase Video[/b][/p][p]- You can watch the <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Product Showcase through the link below.[/p][p][b][u][url="https://www.youtube.com/live/moDl2rFf3dY?t=9001s"]▶ Watch the <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> TGS 2025 Production Showcase[/url][/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]🔹CBT Application Details[/b][/p][p]① Visit the official website below and click the \[Sign up for Closed Beta Test] banner.[/p][p][b][u][url="https://7origin.onelink.me/tV8O/dyn3j8ak"]▶ Go to the <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Official Website[/url][/u][/b][/p][p]② After reviewing the CBT application notes, enter the email address you will use to accept the invitation.[/p][p]③ Complete all required surveys and click the \[Submit Application] button to finish your registration.[/p][p][i]* Selected participants will be contacted individually via the email address entered at the time of application, so please ensure that your information is entered correctly. [/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]More exciting programs are still to come at TGS 2025, and we hope you’ll continue enjoying them with us, Star Guardians![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: PlayStation®5 Pre-order Start and Launch Schedule Announcement
notes.notes:
[p][b]Together We Run, Bound by Destiny[/b][/p][p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> was featured as one of PlayStation’s highly anticipated titles during the [b]Talk Over session[/b] of Sony’s online showcase, [b]State of Play(SOP)[/b].[/p][p]In this session, we announced the [b]official launch schedule[/b] along with the news that the PlayStation® Store [b]pre-order pack[/b] is now available.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope that the news delivered through SOP has brought excitement and anticipation to our Star Guardians, and we will continue striving to return your support with even more updates and content.[/p][p][/p][p]For more information, please refer to the details below.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✦ PlayStation®5 Pre-order Start and Launch Schedule Announcement ✦[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/455cc762f76ba63fbba78ad7a9505f42a6f6654c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🔹[b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Official Launch Schedule[/b][/p][p]- January 28, 2026[/p][p]* Details on the schedule will be further announced in a separate notice.[/p][p][/p][p]🔹[b]State of Play (SOP) Details[/b][/p][p]- State of Play (SOP) is a digital showcase series hosted by Sony that delivers the latest news, game trailers, and updates related to the PlayStation platform.[/p][p]- The Talk Over session is a special feature within SOP, reserved for select highly anticipated titles. It goes beyond simply showing footage, providing in-depth commentary from Sony to highlight the game’s features and appeal.[/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/b6x50tXJLX4"]🎥 [b][u]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Official YouTube[/u][/b][/url][b][u]
[/u][/b][/p][p]🔹[b]PlayStation®5 Pre-Order Pack[/b][/p][p]- By purchasing the package on the PlayStation® Store, you can obtain the ‘7DS Origin (F2P) Special Item Pack (Pre-order Bundle).’[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p align="center"][b]Package Name[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Components[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Pre-order Perks[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td rowspan="3"][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/8d8efe4f9770ecb4f99b980b9cea993aeb2a403d.png"][/img][/p][p align="center"][b]7DS Origin(F2P) Special Item Pack[/b][/p][p align="center"][b](Pre-Order Bundle)[/b][/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p align="center"]Common Ticket x5[/p][p align="center"]Gold x50,000[/p][p align="center"]Premium Mastery EXP x20[/p][p align="center"]Premium Enhancement Stone x20[/p][p align="center"]Premium Refinement Stone x40[/p][p align="center"]HP Recovery Potion x10[/p][p align="center"]Egg Tart x3[/p][p align="center"]Chicken Stew x3[/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p align="center"]Premium Mastery EXP x5[/p][p align="center"]Premium Enhancement Stone x5[/p][p align="center"]Premium Refinement Stone x10[/p][p align="center"]Grilled Beef x3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][/table][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We will continue to do our best to provide you with an enjoyable experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: TGS 2025 D-1 Developer Notes #3
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]PD Koo[/b] of [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Since announcing the CBT recruitment, I’m pleased to return with another Developer Notes.[/p][p]It has already been a month since we unveiled the first trailer during gamescom this past summer.[/p][p][/p][p]Since then, we’ve shared various updates through our official social channels and Discord, including information about mobile pre-registration and its rewards. We’ve also been grateful to see players from around the world steadily signing up for the CBT.[/p][p]Thank you once again for your continued interest and support for <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>. Our development team is working diligently to meet your expectations through ongoing testing and improvements. [/p][p][/p][p]The biggest news we would like to share this time, as previously announced on our official channels, is that we will be attending [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b], taking place on [b]September 25[/b] in Tokyo, Japan.[/p][p]We’re incredibly excited for the opportunity to meet many of you in person and share more of what we’ve been working on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/bb7ae6cf3994fe6c3492143e7fcc50041afaa5cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As this will be our very first global offline event, we feel a mix of excitement and nervous anticipation.[/p][p]Japan holds a special place in our hearts, not only as the home of the original \[The Seven Deadly Sins] series, but also as a country where many long-time fans have shown us their support.[/p][p]That’s why this upcoming appearance at TGS feels all the more meaningful to us.[/p][p][/p][p]It is not just an opportunity to showcase our game through a screen, but a rare and meaningful chance to connect with you face-to-face. We hope to present everything we’ve prepared with our utmost effort, and create a moment that everyone can enjoy together. [/p][p]
[/p][p]In this Developer Notes, we would like to share a closer look at the [b]combat system[/b] in <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>.
[/p][p]As mentioned in our first Developer Notes, combat in <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> revolves around each hero’s use of three different weapons, allowing for a wide variety of playstyles. To make battles even more strategic and dynamic, our team has been developing the [b]Tag Skills[/b] and [b]Burst System,[/b] which further expand on these combat styles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/7af422bfbf8e86bd1465f5de15b2c7f64f7e52e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Tag Skills[/b] are activated when switching heroes and consume a Tag Gauge that fills through normal attacks and skill use. These skills are not just for dealing damage. They are designed to be used strategically in a variety of combat situations, such as countering specific boss patterns or providing buffs to allies. By incorporating these mechanics, we aim to deliver a fast-paced and immersive combat experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/b05208d1eaaff0884dc9e37e88acdfcd159397ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Burst System[/b] is a key feature designed to enhance synergy between elemental attributes and hero combinations. In <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>, each weapon grants its own elemental attribute, and the Burst System plays a central role in utilizing these attributes during combat.[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Burst Gauge[/b] builds up by landing consecutive attacks with the same element, and once activated, it unleashes unique effects depending on the element used. We are currently refining this system to further emphasize the elemental identity of each hero and weapon, and to encourage a wide variety of strategic team compositions based on elemental synergy that we cannot wait to share with you.[/p][p][/p][p]The combat systems introduced above are being developed as key elements in the diverse boss battles you will encounter in <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>.[/p][p]In addition to Tag Skills and the Burst Gauge, each boss will feature unique combat mechanics and distinct strategy points, offering a wide range of tactical approaches and enjoyable challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/8c099289804aa0c42d6212372d1244ec5e71e8ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To give you a better idea, we would like to highlight a few examples in this Developer Notes.
[/p][p]The [b]Red Demon[/b] uses powerful area-of-effect attacks and dangerous patterns, but with well-timed Tag Skills, you can interrupt its strikes and create opportunities to counterattack.
[/p][p]The [b]Gray Demon[/b] takes to the skies after a certain period of time, launching airborne assaults. However, using specific heroes’ Adventure Skills, you can shoot it down, leaving it stunned and giving you the upper hand in battle.
[/p][p][b]Albion[/b] leverages its massive size in a three-phase encounter that cannot be overcome through simple attacks and dodging alone. Victory lies in utilizing environmental elements that appear during the fight to disable the boss and strike at its core on the chest.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/3ff3769cdaed9a745539e753a0f669e01b1c6810.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, combat in <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> is designed to encourage strategic play using Tag Skills and the Burst system to overcome the unique patterns and mechanics of each boss. We are continually refining these features to deliver an even more dynamic and engaging battle experience.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Some of you may have already guessed, but the systems and bosses we have introduced here will be revealed for the very first time at ‘Tokyo Game Show 2025.’ We are truly excited to finally showcase what we’ve been preparing directly on-site.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/d8a35cf86c05de1857c228059ecfcdc30fbf4e52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At this year’s TGS, we will be unveiling [b]a total of 12 playable heroes[/b], along with the[b] [/b]‘[b]Fairy King’s Forest[/b],’ the homeland of the Fairy King, King. Visitors will also be able to experience open-world exploration firsthand, using [b]flying mounts[/b] that were previously only shown in trailers. [/p][p][/p][p]The venue will also feature a variety of stage events, including appearances by the [b]original Japanese voice cast[/b] such as ‘Yuki Kaji,’ who voices Meliodas, as well as [b]PVP showcases featuring popular streamers and a cosplay show[/b]. For those unable to attend in person, the event will be livestreamed on our official X and YouTube channels, so please stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]TGS 2025 marks more than just a hands-on demo. It is the very first opportunity for us to share the core gameplay and vision of <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> directly with players around the world. We believe that the feedback you share with us on-site will serve as a valuable foundation for future development, enabling us to create an even more polished and complete experience.
[/p][p]Lastly, mobile pre-registration and CBT sign-ups are currently underway. By pre-registering, you can receive the character ‘[b]Tioreh[/b],’ the [b]Skyborne Gale Dual Swords Weapon[/b], [b]10 Draw Tickets[/b], as well as a [b]variety of growth materials[/b] and [b]Gold[/b]. The Closed Beta Test will be the very first opportunity to experience the core content of <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> and share your valuable feedback with us.[/p][p]We look forward to your participation in both the pre-registration and CBT. Thank you once again for your continued support, Star Guardians. We will continue doing our best to deliver an adventure you can truly enjoy.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sincerely, PD Koo[/b][/p]

notes.title: TGS 2025 D-3 Booth Event Announcement
notes.notes:
[p][b]Together We Run, Bound by Destiny[/b][/p][p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to share details about the [b]✨booth events✨[/b] for <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> at TGS 2025, which so many of our Star Guardians have been eagerly awaiting![/p][p][/p][p]Take part in the demo event, where you can play Origin in Japan for the very first time, and join the exclusive programs available only at TGS 2025. [/p][p]By participating, you will also have the chance to receive [b]limited Origin merchandise[/b]❣️[/p][p][/p][p]For more information, please refer to the details below![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✦ TGS 2025 D-3 Booth Event Announcement ✦[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/3f7cf25f509aa7435e6cff3c12aeff1c040e75aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🔹Demo Details[/b][/p][p]- At the Demo Zone, you can play <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> on PC and PlayStation®5. The following content will be available:[/p][p]① [b]‘Story Mode’[/b] - Immerse yourself in the adventure through the main storyline[/p][p]② [b]‘Open World Mode’[/b] - Explore the vast continent of Britannia freely[/p][p]③ [b]‘Boss Time Attack Content’[/b] - Experience intense battles against three powerful Demons from the original series[/p][p][/p][p]🔹[b]Booth Event Details[/b][/p][p]- A variety of [b]interactive events[/b] and [b]exciting prizes[/b] will be available at the Origin booth.[/p][p]- All visitors to the Netmarble TGS booth will receive a special gift: an [b]Origin Fan[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]① Stamp Rally[/b][/p][p]- A participation event that uses the leaflet distributed at the Origin booth.[/p][p]- The event consists of three missions, and each time you complete a mission, you will receive a stamp along with special merchandise.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="center"][b]Stamp Rally Prizes 🎁[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/8157f518d3dd39438f1ffa975fa7e628c9e1ab0f.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Sticker (7 types), Hawk Balloon Hairpin,[/p][p align="center"]Hawk Coaster, Clear File Folder[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][i]* One of the seven types of Stickers will be randomly distributed.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]② Giant Gacha[/b][/p][p]- A participation event where completing missions grants you a chance to try the Giant Gacha and win a variety of special merchandise. notes.title: Developer Notes #2
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]PD Koo[/b] of [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]It hasn’t been long since the Developer Commentary video, but with September approaching, I wanted to take this opportunity to share our second Developer Notes.[/p][p] [/p][p]It hasn’t even been a full day yet, but I hope you’ve had a chance to watch the newly released PV trailer.[/p][p]As mentioned in the Developer Commentary video, we revealed a new look at <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> during the gamescom ONL 2025 showcase.[/p][p] [/p][p]One of the highlights of the gamescom ONL PV was being able to share some exciting news.[/p][p]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> will soon be holding its first Closed Beta Test.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are preparing the CBT so that you’ll be able to experience not only the scenes shown in the newly released PV, but also many of the moments featured in past trailers on our official YouTube channel.[/p][p] [/p][p]As this will be our very first CBT, we’re doing our best to ensure that many Star Guardians can take part in the adventure and share their valuable feedback. We truly hope you’ll be interested and look forward to joining us.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll keep this Developer Notes brief as we wrap up with the news of the upcoming CBT.[/p][p]Thank you, as always, to all our Star Guardians for your continued interest and support for <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more details about the CBT through our official Discord and other channels soon.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Sincerely, PD Koo.[/b][/p]

[p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]PD Koo[/b] of [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I would like to begin by sincerely thanking all of you for your patience and support as you await the launch of <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>.[/p][p][/p][p]Our development team will be hosting a Q&A to answer your questions about the game, directly from the team to you. [/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions related to <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>, please feel free to post them in the \[url] channel. Our team will review your questions and share our answers. [/p][p][/p][p]For more information, please refer to the details below.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]◈ <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Developer Q&A ◈[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]🔹 [b]Schedule[/b][/p][p]7/1 (Tue) 2:00 - 7/6 (Sun) 17:59 (PDT)[/p][p]
[/p][p]🔹 [b]How to Participate[/b][/p][p]- Please leave your question for the <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> developers as comments in the [b]official Discord channel[/b] below.[/p][p]-  We will prioritize questions that receive strong support from other Star Guardians or that we find particularly interesting, and will share answers separately at a later time.[/p][p][b][u][url="https://discordapp.com/channels/1375286934858891344/1375369260422922290"]▶ Go to the Developer Q&A Discord Channel[/url][/u][/b][/p][p][i]* The channel will be available upon joining the official <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Discord server.[/i][/p][p][i]* Please note that comments can only be posted in the channel at set intervals. We may not be able to respond to questions submitted outside the designated channel.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Notes[/b][/p][p]- While we may not be able to answer every question, we appreciate your understanding and will do our best to address as many as possible.[/p][p]- The schedule is subject to change or cancellation depending on internal circumstances.[/p][p]- We may not be able to respond to questions that contain inappropriate language, are unrelated to the game, or concern development schedules or certain other topics. [/p][p]- Messages unrelated to the Q&A, or those intended to disrupt the event, may be removed without warning.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We look forward to your interest and participation, Star Guardians. 

Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Developer Notes #1
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Star Guardians.[/p][p]This is [b]PD Koo[/b] of [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]It has already been six years since we first introduced a game based on \[The Seven Deadly Sins].[/p][p]During that time, the support and feedback we received from players around the world have been truly invaluable. Your voices shaped our development, guided our decisions, and encouraged us to reflect deeply on the road ahead. More importantly, they reminded us of the enduring strength of the \[The Seven Deadly Sins] IP and of the immense love you have for it.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, we are taking our first steps on a new journey, one where we reimagine a familiar universe into an entirely new kind of experience.[/p][p][/p][p]With this very first Developer Notes, I would like to briefly share the direction we are pursuing and the kind of experience we are working to deliver.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔹About the Game[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> began with a simple hope: to create a world where players could freely explore the captivating land of Britannia and truly immerse themselves in its story.[/p][p][/p][p]While staying true to the identity of the original work, we reimagined both the combat and storytelling to suit the open-world action RPG genre.[/p][p][/p][p]Unlike our previous title, which closely followed the storyline of the original series, this new series offers an entirely original adventure set within the world of \[The Seven Deadly Sins].[/p][p]Through a multiverse narrative that brings together characters and lore from across the entire franchise, we aim to deliver a story that feels both familiar and refreshingly new.[/p][p]
Our approach to combat began with reimagining the heroes themselves.[/p][p]We aimed to highlight new dimensions of each character by introducing fresh combat styles never seen in the original series, such as Meliodas wielding an axe and Elizabeth taking up a sword. [/p][p]
This idea has shaped the foundation of <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>’s unique battle system.[/p][p]
Combat in <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> changes based on the weapons each hero equips.[/p][p]Each hero can wield up to three different weapons, with their combat style shifting dynamically depending on how those weapons are used together as a set.[/p][p]The game features a four-hero party system, and the same hero can offer entirely different strategies and playstyles depending on your choice of weapons.[/p][p][/p][p]Beyond combat, we are also building a world full of exciting adventures, whether it’s discovering hidden locations scattered across Britannia or taking on powerful boss challenges.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also enjoy Britannia at a slower pace by gathering materials, fishing, and using your gatherings to cook meals or craft equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also collect unique and charming pets to accompany you on your journey. While <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> offers a complete single-player experience, we are also preparing a variety of content that becomes even more rewarding when enjoyed with others. [/p][p][/p][p]More details will be revealed in future Developer Notes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔹 Recent Trailer Reveal & Our Approach to Communication[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Last week, we officially unveiled the first global trailer for <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> at Summer Game Fest 2025 and the Future Games Show.[/p][p]Although short, we put great care into capturing the direction and emotional vision behind this project within that brief moment.[/p][p][/p][p]We are deeply grateful for the enthusiastic responses from players and media around the world following its release.[/p][p]Your excitement has been an incredible encouragement to our team, while also reminding us of the responsibility we carry. It has strengthened our belief in the new possibilities this IP can offer.[/p][p][/p][p]While we cannot reveal everything just yet, we are preparing various ways to connect with you in the near future. As development progresses, we will continue to share how <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> is gradually taking shape.[/p][p][/p][p]We do not see <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> as a one-time finished project, but as a journey we are building together with you.[/p][p]We will continue to share our development directions regularly, and we will do our best to sincerely reflect your feedback as we work to shape a better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Your criticism and encouragement are both genuinely welcome. With a mindset of starting anew and a determination to rise to the challenge once more, we bring this to you with sincerity. [/p][p][/p][p]We ask for your warm support and hope you will walk with us on this journey. [/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sincerely, PD Koo[/b][/p][p]
[/p]
